target_customer: B2B sales teams and businesses doing outbound, from small teams to large enterprises
problem: Sales reps spend hours researching prospects and finding people with a reason to buy now.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription, Starter 99 and Pro 299 dollars per month per site
product_category: AI sales research and outbound agents

founders.name: Finn Mallery
founders.background_notes: Press report says he worked on go to market at Fizz; the YC page lists no background.

founders.name: Kenson Chung
prior_employers: Enterprise sales platform (unnamed on YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says former CTO of an enterprise sales platform and built research workflows used by sales teams at companies over 1B revenue.

investors: Shopify COO and founders of Yext, BloomTech, LayerZero and Fizz (angels)

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents that research prospects and write messages combine web data, LLM prompting and CRM and inbox integrations, standard but with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Many AI prospecting tools existed by late 2024 and the underlying models are shared, so copying was easy.

market_need_then: VentureBeat coverage of the seed describes demand from property management and real estate sales teams. A report cites 50,000 dollars in monthly recurring revenue during beta, which is a secondary claim.

branding.domain_note: Company site origamiagents.com and product site origami.chat; the name Origami has since replaced Origami Agents per one aggregator.

identity.logo: Minimal logo with a dark mode variant
identity.visual_style: Minimal layout with pipeline tables and message previews
identity.voice_and_tone: Short, direct and outcome focused, tagline Origami gets customers for you.

rebrands.why: Not stated. One aggregator says the company now trades as Origami.

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt number one product of the day badge shown on the site; VentureBeat called it a hot YC startup.

brand_strength.rationale: Some press and a Product Hunt win, but a generic word shared with many products and a two domain setup.

outcome_analysis: Origami is active with about 10 people, raised a 2M seed in January 2025 and claims over 2,000 businesses use it, with large brand logos on its site. It began with property management and real estate customers and widened to other B2B sectors. Traction numbers are mostly company claims.
notes: Seed confirmed by the company blog and VentureBeat; the company page says led by Y Combinator while another source lists Pioneer Fund, so the lead is unclear. An unrelated Origami's AI raising 500K appeared in results and is not this company. Competitor searches returned no dated comparison, so the list is empty. Customer logo claims on the site are not verified as paying.
